I started the interspeech conference with a tutorial on domain
adaptation for machine learning. The main theme of the 3 hour tutorial
was to present machine learning and speech processing techniques in the
same unified taxonomy, which was 3 categories of methods: instance-based
methods, feature transformation-based methods, and model-based methods.
Fei Sha (USC) and Brian Kingsbury (IBM) were the two presenters. One of
the strengths of this tutorial was the comprehensive references given,
without a self-promotion bias. It was cool to see my former labmate
Abhinav Sethy and classmate Hal Daumé get prominent citations. One thing
I’ll be looking into more is the Blitzer reference about domain
adaptation for sentiment analysis. The slides are online at
<https://rainflower.usc.edu/wiki/projects/is2012tutorial/Interspeech_2012_Tutorial.html>
